task: Browse the Coursera website and find the price required for one year of Coursera Plus. How much is the discount? Then list 3 companies that work with Coursera.
answer:
FINAL: One year of Coursera Plus costs $239, with an advertised 40% discount (“Save 40%”). Three companies that work with Coursera are Google, IBM, and Microsoft.

Evidence: https://www.coursera.org/courseraplus — the Coursera Plus pricing card with “Billed Annually” selected shows “$239/year” and “Save 40%”; the page’s “Learn from 350+ leading universities and companies” section lists Google, IBM, and Microsoft. Checked October 27, 2026. Screenshot: final.png.
